units.source_text: 薰中纳言久不访问宇治八亲王旧邸，

en.t: For a long time, Middle Counselor Kaoru had not visited the old residence of Prince Hachi at Uji,

units.source_text: 似觉亡人面影日渐疏远，心甚悲伤，

en.t: and feeling that the image of the departed was growing more distant day by day, he was deeply saddened,

units.source_text: 便于九月二十日过后来至山庄。

en.t: so after the twentieth day of the ninth month, he came to the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 但觉山中秋风甚厉，木叶乱飞。

en.t: He found only that the autumn wind in the mountains was fierce, and leaves were flying wildly about.

units.source_text: 守护这山庄的，只是凄凉骚乱的宇治川水声，

en.t: What seemed to guard the villa was only the desolate, restless sound of the Uji River,

units.source_text: 难得看到人影。

en.t: and scarcely a human figure could be seen.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言一见便觉黯然销魂，伤心无极。

en.t: At the sight of it, Middle Counselor Kaoru was overcome with gloom and immeasurable sorrow.

units.source_text: 他召唤老尼姑弁君，

en.t: He summoned the elderly nun Ben no Kimi,

units.source_text: 弁君走到纸隔扇门口，

en.t: and Ben no Kimi came to the doorway of the paper sliding partition,

units.source_text: 站在一个深青色帷屏后面，

en.t: standing behind a deep blue-green curtain screen,

units.source_text: 告道：“恕我失礼了！

en.t: and said, "Please forgive my discourtesy.

units.source_text: 年纪一大，颜面丑陋可怕，见不得人了。”

en.t: Now that I am old, my face has grown ugly and frightening, and I can no longer show myself to anyone."

units.source_text: 便不走出帷屏外面来。

en.t: So she did not come out from behind the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言对她说道：“我推想你在这里何等寂寞啊！

en.t: Middle Counselor Kaoru said to her, "I can imagine how lonely you must be here.

units.source_text: 除你以外，我更无知心之人，所以特来和你谈谈。

en.t: Apart from you, I have no one else who understands my heart, so I have come especially to talk with you.

units.source_text: 不知不觉之间，又过了许多时光！”

en.t: Before we knew it, so much time has passed again."

units.source_text: 说时泪盈于睫，那老尼姑更是流泪不止。

en.t: As he spoke, tears filled his eyes, and the old nun wept all the more without stopping.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言又说：“回想起来，大小姐为二小姐的终身大事操心，

en.t: Middle Counselor Kaoru went on, "Thinking back, it was when the elder lady was worrying over the younger lady's future marriage,

units.source_text: 正是去年这个时节。

en.t: at just this season last year.

units.source_text: 悲伤无时或已，就中秋风逼人之时更甚。

en.t: My sorrow never truly ceases, and it is especially severe when the autumn wind presses upon me.

units.source_text: 大小姐所忧虑的果然不错，

en.t: The elder lady's worries proved to be justified,

units.source_text: 我隐约闻知二小姐与匂亲王的姻缘的确不甚美满呢。

en.t: for I have heard faintly that the younger lady's marriage with Prince Niou is indeed not very happy.

units.source_text: 思想起来，事事都可痛心啊！”

en.t: When I think of it, everything is heartbreaking."

units.source_text: 又说：“不过不论情形这样或那样，

en.t: He also said, "Still, whatever the circumstances may be,

units.source_text: 只要活在世上，将来或有否极泰来之日。

en.t: as long as one remains alive in this world, a day may come when misfortune turns to good.

units.source_text: 只是大小姐怀着这忧虑而死去，

en.t: But the elder lady died while still carrying this worry,

units.source_text: 我总觉得是我的过失，想起了不胜悲伤。

en.t: and I cannot help feeling it was my fault; whenever I remember it, my grief is unbearable.

units.source_text: 最近左大臣家的事情，其实不必担心，

en.t: As for the recent matter involving the Left Minister's family, there is really no need to worry,

units.source_text: 这是世间常有之事。

en.t: for such things often happen in the world.

units.source_text: 匂亲王虽然又娶了六女公子，

en.t: Although Prince Niou has also taken the Sixth Lady as a wife,

units.source_text: 但对二小姐绝无疏远之色。

en.t: he shows no sign at all of becoming distant toward the younger lady.

units.source_text: 说来说去，可悲的正是那个化作灰烬的人！

en.t: In the end, the truly pitiable one is the person who has turned to ashes.

units.source_text: 死，原是谁也不能逃避之事，

en.t: Death is something that no one can escape,

units.source_text: 然而或先或后，总是使人悲伤难堪的啊！”

en.t: yet whether it comes sooner or later, it always brings grief too painful to bear."

units.source_text: 说罢又哭泣起来。

en.t: When he had finished speaking, he began to weep again.
